title: Go/No-Go Sentinel: Field Guide and Signal Ledger (Jul 2026) - Draft
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, ops-friendly field guide for the day-of release (go/no-go decision workflow), a curated ledger of live signals we watch during rollout,
and a terse post-release notes template. Intended audience: release leads, SREs, on-call engineers, and product owners.

Context / Scope:
- Covers feature bundle: routing-tiered-fallbacks + cache-prefetch optimization (canary).
- Deployment window: 2026-07-09 02:00–10:00 UTC (primary lane).
- Targets hosted + dedicated fleets in us-west1 and eu-west2.

Quick Go/No-Go checklist (first-pass, 15 minutes pre-launch):
- All blocking CI green (unit/integration/e2e): REL-2719 ✅
- Migration hooks staged? (KV schema bump verified) ✅
- Canary infra reserved and smoke instances provisioned ✅
- Observability: dashboards replicated, alert routing sanity checked ✅
- Rollout runbook open in Slack channel #release-2719 and everyone acked ✅

Signal Ledger — core signals to watch (primary owners in parens):
1) Latency (P50/P95/P99 across token generation) — baseline = P50 22ms / P95 95ms (obs: Marcus)
   - Thresholds: P95 increase > 40% over baseline -> immediate hold
2) Error rate (5xx / model-timeouts) — baseline <0.2% (Aisha)
   - Thresholds: sustained >0.7% over 5m -> initiate rollback
3) Token cost vs expected (tokens/sec * avg GPU utilization) — budget watch (Finance alert)
   - Thresholds: burst >1.5x expected sustained for >10m -> throttle canary
4) Queue depth / headroom on serving nodes (Jon)
   - Thresholds: queue length > 3s effective latency equivalent -> hold expansion
5) End-to-end user-facing error surfaces (customer reports + synthetic probes)
   - Slack trigger: even single SEV affecting core flows -> pause rollout
6) Canary-specific model qualité checks: perplexity drift on eval set, hallucination rate on curated prompts
   - Automated eval run every 10 minutes; >2.5% regression -> hold

Rollout cadence and calendar (compact):
- T0 = 2026-07-09 02:00 UTC: deploy canary to 0.5% global traffic (15m warmup)
- T0+30m: evaluate signals (15m observation window). If green, move to 3% traffic
- T0+2h: observe 1h (metric aggregation windows). If green, expand to 25%
- T0+6h: final safety window; if green and product signoff, expand to 100% over next 1h with progressive buckets (25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%)
- Hard cutoff: 2026-07-09 10:00 UTC — any incomplete rollout will be halted and rolled back to previous model version at 10:15 UTC unless approved by exec on-call

Escalation matrix (fast):
- On-call SRE (primary): Marcus Lee — Slack @marcus, PagerDuty PD-ops-team
- Release lead: Elena Ortiz — Slack @elena, mobile on-call
- Product owner: Priya N. (for customer-impact decisions)
- Eng director (for cross-org rollbacks): Rafael Gomez

Rollback decision matrix (summary):
- Immediate rollback triggers (automated or manual):
  * Sustained error rate >0.7% for 5m
  * P95 latency >2x baseline for 10m and P50 degraded >30%
  * Model-quality regression above threshold (>2.5% on smoke prompts)
  * Critical customer-impacting SEV (ops + product confirm)
- Partial hold / throttle triggers:
  * Token cost spike (1.5x expected) but without error increase — throttle canary to cap 
  * Regional anomalies limited to single region: shift traffic away from region, continue monitoring

Quick smoke tests (run after deployment to canary nodes):
- /healthz for all services (must be 200 99.9% of checks)
- Latency probes for 3 synthetic prompts (expect <200ms p50)
- Long-sequence generation test (150 tokens) to validate KV cache behavior
- Auth and rate-limit sanity for tokenized routes
- Model eval script: run smoke_eval.sh against canary model (output must pass threshold)

Telemetry instrumentation checklist (must be green pre-launch):
- Canary tag applied to all spans and traces for new version
- Token-level billing counters enabled and live -> Influx/Prometheus
- Alerting rules set with temporary reduced thresholds for canary (to be relaxed post-100%)
- Error budget burn dashboard populated and shared link in runbook

Communication plan (brief):
- 30m before deploy: brief in #release-2719 (release lead)
- At canary expansion steps: post short note with metrics snapshot
- Any pause/rollback: page stakeholders + create incident channel #incident-REL-2719
- Post-release: publish summary in weekly-release-digest and notify account teams if customers in test region saw change

Post-release notes template (to fill within 2h post 100%):
- Release ID: REL-2719
- Deployed by: <engineer> at <timestamp UTC>
- Components changed: serving-runtime v3.12.1, routing-controller v1.4.0
- Rollout windows and final timing: canary start, expansion timestamps, completion timestamp
- Signals summary: latency P50/P95 delta, error rate delta, token cost delta
- Known issues and mitigations: list any followups
- Next actions: follow-up tickets, postmortem owners if degraded

Notes to self / open questions (todo):
- Confirm finance alert hook is wired for token-burst alarms — file ticket if not
- Decide whether to auto-scale canary duration to 2h for heavy models (hold for discussion)
- Validate that canary eval set includes recent customer prompts for better coverage

Appendix: useful quick links and run snippets
- Smoke rollout command (infra-runbook snippet): infractl deploy --canary-version=serving-v3.12.1 --fraction=0.005 --regions=us-west1,eu-west2
- Quick dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-infra/release/REL-2719-sentinel
- Slack channel: #release-2719

End of doc.
